name: Split Type Transition
description: A sliced-letter entrance with a fitted title and adjustable assembly timing.

settings.label: Play on entry
settings.description: Replay the entrance on mount and settings changes. Disable for manually triggered navigation.

settings.label: Reveal content
settings.description: Choose the bundled wordmark, editable text or a monochrome custom logo. Each keeps the sliced entrance and cover-to-text color handoff.

settings.label: Custom logo
settings.description: For Custom logo: transparent PNG/WebP or a same-origin/CORS-enabled SVG URL. The alpha silhouette is tinted by Cover label and Text colors. Empty input falls back to Transition label.

settings.label: Logo aspect ratio
settings.description: Custom logo width divided by height. Set the original ratio to preserve proportions; e.g. 800 × 200 = 4.

settings.label: Transition label
settings.description: Used for Custom text and when Custom logo is empty. Up to 12 characters.

settings.label: Heading
settings.description: Demo headline. Line breaks are preserved; custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Caption
settings.default: Distinctive by design. Built to leave an impression.
settings.description: Demo supporting copy. Custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Canvas
settings.description: Receiving canvas behind the demo image. Visible while the image loads or wherever content leaves the canvas uncovered.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: Base color for the demo headline, supporting copy and credit. The replay action and overlay labels use their own colors.

settings.label: Cover
settings.description: Opaque cover and reveal layer color.

settings.label: Cover label
settings.description: Color of the assembled title and its animated letter slices.

settings.label: Minimum height
settings.description: Minimum receiving area height in pixels. The layout follows its container width.

settings.label: Content settle
settings.description: Time in milliseconds for the underlying content to settle from Content starting scale to normal size. Letter assembly and title settling have separate duration controls.

settings.label: Navigation cover
settings.description: Outgoing cover duration in milliseconds. Applies to Next scene, cover() and navigate(), not Replay reveal.

settings.label: Covered hold
settings.description: Additional delay in milliseconds before background clearing and title settling. Added to Title delay; letter assembly keeps its own timing.

settings.label: Entry delay
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds before letter-band assembly starts. Title delay independently sets when the background clears and title settles.

settings.label: Slice assembly
settings.description: Time in milliseconds for each horizontal letter band to assemble.

settings.label: Slice stagger
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds between the six bands within each letter.

settings.label: Letter stagger
settings.description: Additional delay in milliseconds between successive letters.

settings.label: Title settle
settings.description: Title settling duration in milliseconds, at every viewport size including cards.

settings.label: Content starting scale
settings.description: Initial content scale during the reveal; 1 keeps the content size unchanged.

settings.label: Motion curve
settings.description: Curve for letter-band assembly, title settling and content scaling. The 400ms background and content fades use this curve too.

settings.label: Title settle delay
settings.description: Time in milliseconds before the background clears and title settles. Hold adds to this offset.

settings.label: Title settle travel
settings.description: Title starting offset in pixels. In frames below 1200px, travel is bounded to keep the title inside the frame.

settings.label: Title starting scale
settings.description: Title starting scale. Below 1200px this is capped at 1.22 and fitted to the frame. Set 1 to disable title scaling.
